projects.title: Elementesse
projects.description: A budget-focused e-commerce website built from the ground up, combining custom HTML, CSS and JavaScript with WordPress and WooCommerce. The storefront is structured for clear product discovery, straightforward shopping and value-conscious customers. Developed for and property of Rayd Trading LLC.
